name: lawful
description: Apply software, visual, and UX laws to technical decisions and product critiques.

interface.shortDescription: Apply the right laws to software, visual, and UX work.
interface.longDescription: Bundles Laws of Software, Laws of Taste, and Laws of UX as three focused skills for architecture decisions, visual direction, and interaction critique.
defaultPrompt: Review this technical design with Laws of Software and recommend the smallest reversible path.
Critique this visual surface with Laws of Taste and give me the strongest few changes.
Review this product flow with the most relevant Laws of UX.
